note: Distribution notices (brand/decisions.md Part 10). Every deck, proposal, report and contract has one classification (who may see it) and one status (whether it may be used). The footer shows both in one line, for example 'Confidential · Draft · Do not use'. Individual slides or pages can carry a stricter status. Wording is a business template; have counsel approve it before relying on it. {recipient} and {validity} are filled from the document settings.

confidential.label: Confidential
confidential.line: Confidential. Prepared for {recipient}. Do not copy, forward or distribute without the written consent of Ocean RCS.

proposal.label: Confidential proposal
proposal.line: Confidential proposal for {recipient}. Pricing valid for {validity}. Not binding until a contract is signed by both parties.

investor.label: Confidential · For discussion only
investor.line: Confidential. For discussion only. Not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.
investor.disclaimer: This presentation is confidential and is provided for discussion purposes only. It is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security. Forward-looking statements, projections and estimates reflect current assumptions, are not guarantees and may differ materially from actual results. Do not copy, forward or distribute without the written consent of Ocean RCS.

internal.label: Internal use only
internal.line: Internal use only. Do not share outside Ocean RCS.

public.label: Not confidential
public.line: Not confidential. May be shared in full with attribution to Ocean RCS.

draft.label: Draft · Do not use
draft.line: Draft for discussion. Do not use, rely on or distribute. Figures and terms may change.

specimen.label: Design specimen · Do not use
specimen.line: Design specimen with illustrative figures and representative images. Do not use for any commercial purpose.

do-not-use.label: Do not use
do-not-use.line: Do not use, rely on or distribute this material.

superseded.label: Superseded · Do not use
superseded.line: Superseded. Do not use; refer to the current version.
